mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a negative linear relationship with S&P 500 20-day forward returns; higher rates compress equity valuations through increased discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the negative correlation is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% and decline in employment below 137000 thousand signals a recessionary labor market, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing risk aversion, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS < 137000, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200, the 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the real economy, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing recession risk, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand (HOUST < 1500) signals a weakening real estate market, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1500, the 5-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 12000 billion (GDPC1 < 12000) signals weak economic growth, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 < 12000, the 60-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive.
